The debate on how to regulate artificial intelligence is intensifying worldwide. From safety guardrails and algorithmic accountability to cyber risks highlighted by CERT-In and the growing divide between tech superpowers and the Global South, regulating AI has become one of the defining challenges of our time.
In this deep-dive explainer, The Hindu explores the major hurdles of AI governance, the limits of self-regulation, and what India and other nations must do to build safe, resilient, and native AI ecosystems. Featuring insights and analysis from policy experts and technology researchers.
